idea: NORMAL regime SHORT filter — block SHORT entries when regime is NORMAL
rationale: Data shows SHORT signals lose -.13 net in NORMAL (13 winners +$0.54, 13 losers -$1.67). But they WIN in EXTREME (+$4.35) and HIGH (+$3.40). Filtering SHORT in NORMAL could save ~$1.13/7d without affecting EXTREME/HIGH wins.
risk: low — only blocks SHORT in one regime, EXTREME/HIGH unaffected
impact_on_winners: Checked: SHORT winners in NORMAL are small (+$0.54 total) vs losses ($1.67). Net positive to filter.

idea: pullback-entry- SHORT: add MIN_RSI_ENTRY=30 filter (prevent shorting oversold)
rationale: pullback-entry- is the #1 STAR signal (32T/7d +$1.85) but has 11 losers. The rr_engine_resistance exits suggest we enter SHORT when price is at support. If RSI is oversold (<30), we are catching a falling knife in reverse. Session brain confirms: "shorting into oversold = catching falling knife"
expected_impact: Block 2-4 losing trades/7d, preserving the 20 winners
risk: low — only filters extreme oversold entries
impact_on_winners: Checked: no winning pullback-entry- SHORT had RSI < 30 at entry (all were in 35-55 range)

idea: pump-chain+ LONG: already killed, but consider pump-chain- in NORMAL — its avg_pnl_pct is -0.03% (breakeven). Filter SHORT in NORMAL only.
rationale: pump-chain- SHORT 7d: 39T +$0.42. But NORMAL regime SHORTs are drag. EXTREME SHORT winners dominate. A regime filter on pump-chain- could improve R:R.
impact_on_winners: Need to verify how many pump-chain- NORMAL trades are winners

idea: Add trend_purity to VOL_PHASE_MULTS with EXTREME multiplier 0.3 (penalized, not blocked)
rationale: trend_purity+ LONG has 50% WR in EXTREME regime (8 trades, -$0.15). Small sample but consistent losses. Adding penalty (0.3x) reduces confidence by 70%, making it harder to fire in EXTREME. Safer than hard block (0.0) since there are 4 winning trades (+$0.56).
expected_impact: -$0.15/7d drag reduced, +2-3% WR for trend_purity+ in EXTREME
impact_on_winners: Checked: 4 winning trades in EXTREME (+$0.56) will still fire but with lower confidence. 4 losing trades (-$0.71) will be harder to fire.

idea: Regime-gate pullback-entry- SHORT to EXTREME+HIGH only
rationale: pullback-entry- SHORT: EXTREME 9T 77.8% WR +$1.11, HIGH 17T 64.7% WR +$0.78, NORMAL 7T 42.9% WR -$0.24. NORMAL is dead weight.
17:00-22:00 UTC: 82T 60.8% WR +$1.66/7d. 19:00 alone 83.3% WR +$1.62. US session = best performance. Boost confidence 10-15%.

idea: pump-chain+ kill candidate — 25% WR SL hits -$0.78/7d
rationale: pump-chain+ LONG atr_sl_hit: 8T 25% WR -$0.78/7d. Worst active LONG signal by SL hit loss.

24h data shows rr_engine_resistance exits SHORT signals prematurely in HIGH regime. 6 trades hit this exit, 50% WR, -$0.14. In EXTREME, the same exit has 77.8% WR for pullback-entry-. The resistance levels are wider in HIGH, triggering exits before the trade develops.
expected_impact: +$0.10-0.20/24h from fewer premature SHORT exits in HIGH

idea: SHORT entry confidence floor by regime
rationale: SHORT signals in 24h average -$0.38 while LONG +$0.34. In HIGH regime, SHORT has 50% WR. Adding CONF_FILTER_MIN=75 for SHORT entries in HIGH regime would filter marginal SHORT entries. 7d pullback-entry- SHORT in HIGH has 64.7% WR +$0.78 — signal works, just some entries are low quality.
expected_impact: Filter 1-2 marginal SHORT entries per day, improve SHORT WR by 5-10%

idea: Time-of-day filter for EXTREME regime trades
rationale: EXTREME regime trades 00:00-06:00 UTC have 5/6 winners (KAS +0.29, PONS +0.24, BIGTIME +0.21). 06:00-12:00 UTC have 3/5 winners. Night session shows better EXTREME performance.
expected_impact: Marginal — system already handles EXTREME well (65.4% WR)

idea: SHORT entry minimum support distance filter — block SHORT within 2% of nearest support
rationale: pullback-entry- SHORT has 16T/7d rr_engine_resistance exits avg -1.83%. Root cause: SHORT entries near support levels — price bounces from support, SHORT exits at resistance break. If we add MIN_SUPPORT_DISTANCE_PCT=2.0 to SHORT entry logic, we block entries where nearest support is within 2% of current price. This prevents the most common losing pattern.
expected_impact: Block 4-6 losing SHORT entries per 7d, preserving ~$0.70-1.00/7d
risk: medium — could reduce SHORT trade frequency
impact_on_winners: Need to verify: check if any winning SHORT entries had support within 2%

idea: NORMAL regime confidence penalty — 0.5x multiplier for all signals in NORMAL
rationale: NORMAL regime has 75T/7d -$2.21 drag. Most signals designed for trending markets. Adding ('NORMAL','*'): 0.5 to VOL_PHASE_MULTS would reduce confidence by 50% in NORMAL, filtering marginal entries while preserving high-confidence trades.
risk: medium — could reduce trade frequency in NORMAL
impact_on_winners: Need to check: NORMAL winners that would be blocked by 50% confidence reduction

idea: trend_purity+ volume confirmation in EXTREME — require volume_breakout+ confluence
rationale: 48h data: trend_purity+,volume-breakout-long+ (BIGTIME +3.95%) won. trend_purity+ alone in EXTREME has 50% WR. If we require volume confirmation for trend_purity+ LONG entries in EXTREME, we keep the winners (volume-confirmed) and filter the losers (no volume).
expected_impact: Improve trend_purity+ EXTREME WR from 50% to ~70%
risk: low — only adds filter to one signal in one regime
impact_on_winners: BIGTIME +3.95% (volume-breakout-long+) would still win. PONS +6.27%, KAS +4.60% — need to check if volume confirmed.
